A Clever Fusion
Jun 2026 • Solo
I ordered the Photine. I could clearly taste both the pho and poutine elements. Neither flavor overpowered the other, making it a clever fusion dish. The stretchy cheese was a highlight and the portion was filling. However, the overall flavor felt a bit muted and the meat wasn't tender. Despite those issues, the dish was creative, enjoyable, and thoughtfully prepared, and I would still come back to try some of their other dishes. Also, the seller was really nice and kind, which is a big plus for me.

Food with family vibes
Feb 2026 • Business
If you want award winning food but with the feeling of home cooked Vietnamese comfort food, this is the place to go. Mama Dung and Papa Chào are the most likeable couple. Not only phenomenal cooks, but incredibly warm hosts too. We felt like we were eating with family. The best pho I've ever tasted. I would 100% recommend. Mama Dungs recipes feature on the Wagamama recipe book and they are also listed in the Michelin Guide.

Best recommendation of Michelin
Jan 2026 • Couples
In 2 weeks in Ho Chi Minh City, I visited a dozen establishments with a Michelin recommendation, I find this cafe very underrated, surprised that so few reviews. In my opinion, this is the best Michelin recommendation I've ever been to. Be on a quiet, cozy street, there were few people in the cafe, the service was good and fast, the price tag was normal, the fried chicken broke my heart! Don't be lazy walking to this spot 3km from the centre, you'll definitely not regret it!

A little Vietnamese restaurant with a little atmosphere
Feb 2024 • Solo
A little Vietnamese restaurant with a little atmosphere. They have chicken pho and beef pho, and even northern-style Hanoi pho. They also have some special dishes of their own, but I only love pho. It just so happens that you can order a small portion of pho for only 50,000 yuan a bowl. So I ordered one portion of chicken pho and one portion of beef pho, plus a piece of special fried chicken. As a carnivore, it is really satisfying! By the way, you can choose multiple toppings for their beef pho, so you can choose any type of beef you like.

Mama Makes You Feel At Home
Dec 2023 • Family
What a fabulous meal we had at Phö Chào. Mama Dung is most wonderful, beautiful and humble host. The food was absolutely fabulous too. We were with a family group of 10 which was a mixture of young children, teens, and adults. 

Many had never experienced the joys of a good bowl of phö before. I myself had to try the Phötine. It's one of those dishes that you think shouldn't work together, but it completely does. Delicious. 
The friend chicken was excellent, and the numerous different bowls of phö completely satisfied. 
I would absolutely recommend going here to eat. 
I can completely understand why they were recently nominated for the Michelin guide.

Heaven-like, from main course to dessert
Apr 2021 • Friends
I came there on a holiday, mid afternoon for a late lunch. There are top 3 that you MUST TRY:
1. I ordered pho-tine (a lovely creation & combination between Vietnamese & Canadian cuisine). Lots of crispy fries, tonnes of cheese, beef gravies, & stir fried vegetables around the bowl. Quite a big portion to me but I consumed it well since too hungry. 
2. For the drinks, I got recommendation for a sparkling fermented organic Kombucha Tea, which tasted lovely, feeling like I was having a light sour cider or bubble rosé. 
3. Last but not least, the dessert, man you need to try the chilled coconut dessert. Soft coconut gel, creamy coconut milk & fresh coconut flesh, served with ice. I was feeling like in heaven haha
